# Talk: Xenomorph (deleted article) [italic]This is the talk page for a deleted article. The article was removed for failing ColonyPedia's notability and sanity guidelines. The talk page is kept for the record.[/italic]
## PROPOSED FOR DELETION This article describes a large black animal with a long head, acid for blood and a habit of living in colony vents. There are no photographs, no specimens and no sources except a marine's interview in a canteen. Delete. [color=#72777D]Editor HelpfulAdmin, 2182[/color]
## KEEP Keep. My cousin was on a garrison that went quiet. The Company says it was a reactor fault. My cousin did not work near the reactor. [color=#72777D]Editor shepherd_girl, 2182[/color]
## REPLY Personal stories are not sources. Please read the guidelines on original research. [color=#72777D]Editor HelpfulAdmin, 2182[/color]
## KEEP, STRONG Keep. I have added three sources: a Colonial Marines field report, an insurance claim and a children's drawing that is far too accurate. [color=#72777D]Editor bughunt_vet, 2183[/color]
## REPLY The field report has been classified since you added it. The insurance claim has been withdrawn. The drawing is not a source. The drawing is very upsetting. [color=#72777D]Editor HelpfulAdmin, 2183[/color]
## DELETE Delete. There is no such animal. I have been asked to say there is no such animal. [color=#72777D]Editor wy_comms_4, 2183[/color]
## COMMENT Who asked you? [color=#72777D]Editor shepherd_girl, 2183[/color]
## RESULT Deleted. The animal described does not meet notability guidelines. Editors are reminded to be civil and not to post pages of the article to the colony noticeboard, which several of you have done. [color=#72777D]Editor HelpfulAdmin, 2183[/color]
## COMMENT [color=#AA3333]Restore the article. The marines will need it.[/color] [color=#72777D]Editor unsigned, IP address on a colony not listed in the ICSC register[/color]
